title: Busiest Moment

concept.title: Starts and ends as separate sorted lists
body: To find how many intervals are active at the same time, you do not need to compare all pairs. Sort the **starts** and the **ends** separately. Then sweep through time: every start adds one active interval, every end removes one. The largest number of active intervals seen during the sweep is the answer.

body.code:
starts.sort(); ends.sort()
i = j = cur = best = 0
while i < n:
    if starts[i] < ends[j]:     # an interval begins before the next one ends
        cur += 1; i += 1
        best = max(best, cur)
    else:
        cur -= 1; j += 1

body: Here an interval `[s, e)` includes `s` but not `e`, so an interval that ends at time 5 does not overlap one that starts at time 5: the end is processed first (`starts[i] < ends[j]` is false when they are equal).

statement: There are `n` events. Event `i` starts at time `s` and ends at time `e` (it is active during `[s, e)`: it includes the start but not the end moment). Print the largest number of events that are active at the same moment.
inputFormat: Each of the next `n` lines has `s` and `e` with `s < e`.

examples.note: At time 2 or 3 two events are active. The event ending at 4 does not overlap the one starting at 4.

hints: Sort the start times and the end times separately.
Sweep: if the next start is before the next end, one more event is active; otherwise one event ended.
When a start and an end are at the same time, process the end first.

explanation: Two sorted lists of start and end times are merged like in merge sort. The counter of active events rises at a start and falls at an end; its maximum is the answer.
solution.complexity: Time O(n log n), space O(n).

code.python:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

n = int(input())
ev = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]

starts = sorted(s for s, e in ev)
ends = sorted(e for s, e in ev)
i = j = cur = best = 0
while i < n:
    if starts[i] < ends[j]:
        cur += 1
        i += 1
        best = max(best, cur)
    else:
        cur -= 1
        j += 1
print(best)
